newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares rise in upbeat market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares rise in upbeat market.

text.p: Egyptian shares rose on Tuesday in an upbeat market partly buoyed by real estate and banks.
"The market was more upbeat in the last couple of days. Volume was brisk. We've seen some stocks that continue to perform," said broker Aly al-Tahry.

The Capital Market Authority's (CMA) overall index rose 1.13 points to 235.71 with a turnover of 14.16 million pounds ($4.16 million), up from turnover of 77.29 million pounds ($22.73 million) the day before.
National Societe General Bank and Medinet Nasr Housing and Development, one of the most successful privatisations of the year, also performed, brokers said.
Medinet Nasr traded as high as 190 during the day closing at 187, brokers said. Heliopolis Housing and Development gained 10 to end at 187.00

Milling shares continued to trade actively. East Delta Flour Mills rose 0.65 pounds to close at 36.5. Upper Egypt Flour Mills rose 1.28 to 47.28 pounds. Central and West Delta Flour Mills ended 1.8 up at 60 pounds.
The CMA index for openly traded firms fell to 345.57 points from Monday's 346.55 points and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 168.18 points from 166.66.
